## Do I Really Need to Worry About Token Efficiency?

- Maybe not now, but eventually. The more workflows we hand to AI, the more tokens we will use.
- The less we use tools that optimize token usage, the more we will have to pay to AI companies.
- Efficient token usage -> smaller context windows -> locally hosted models become feasible -> safer use with confidential data
